card.name: Start of a drug name being spelled out
card.fires_on: The first piece of a brand or generic drug name that is split into several parts, such as FER-ABRIGHT, NU-ZYRA or brom-ocriptine. It appears in dosing and warnings text where the drug is named again.

modes.label: Repeated brand name
modes.description: The opening piece of an uppercase brand name that has already appeared in the passage.

modes.label: Generic name start
modes.description: The opening piece of a lowercase generic drug name, split into parts.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward finishing the drug name by continuing it with its remaining pieces, not with unrelated words.
card.plain: It lights up on the first chunk of a long drug name that is about to be spelled out in full.
